task.title: P6-076: Register the remaining Android probes in end2end/package.json
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-076. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Register the remaining Android probes in `end2end/package.json`** (rescoped 2026-07-30 — **the entry's list is out of date**: 11 of 21 are now registered, `android-rail-check` among them, and two probes the entry predates, `android-catalog-paging-check` and `android-owned-badge-check`, are unregistered too). Re-enumerate against the current tree, then register the lot in one commit. An unregistered probe is one nobody runs.
